GFAs may be useful to understand the underlying processes of various neurodegeneratve diseases.

The main takeaway from our work is that
GFAs are not a simple aging‐related phenomenon.
the formation and distribution of GFAs may be associated with the diagnosis and the underlying processes of neurodegenerative disorders.
